a11y.coloursHelp: Everything colour-coded — splits ahead or behind, warnings, checkpoint gates, the route, tyre grip, the map — in colours that read apart, always with a sign, shape or word as well.
a11y.flashingHelp: Reduced: nothing blinks — the shift light and the warning lamps glow steadily. Full: they blink, never more than three times a second.
a11y.guidesHelp: More visible: bigger, brighter arrows on the road, taller gates that glow at night, a thicker route line on the maps.
a11y.motionHelp: Reduced: no camera shake, no motion blur, no speed effects (the view widening and speed lines), menus that don't slide.
a11y.photo.settings: Flashing effects are reduced by default. Settings → Accessibility also turns off camera shake and speed effects.
a11y.photo.text: A very small number of people may have a seizure when exposed to certain lights, patterns or images, such as flashing lights in video games, even with no history of epilepsy. If you or anyone in your family has had a seizure or epilepsy, talk to a doctor before playing. Stop playing at once and see a doctor if you feel dizzy, have blurred vision, eye or muscle twitches, lose awareness, feel disoriented, or have any involuntary movement.
a11y.photo.title: Photosensitivity warning
a11y.visualSoundsHelp: Tyre grip shown on a car outline, engine damage and overheating warnings in words, arrows to cars close by, and crashes and gear grinds written under the speed.
aids.abs.help: Stops the wheels locking under hard braking, so you can still steer
aids.abs.name: ABS
aids.countersteer.help: Keyboard and gamepad: steering helps catch slides
aids.countersteer.name: Countersteer assist
aids.drift.help: Keyboard and gamepad: holds a drift once it starts (stability control allows more slide)
aids.drift.name: Drift assist
aids.esc.help: Brakes single wheels to stop a spin or tighten understeer
aids.esc.name: Stability control
aids.revProtection.help: Refuses a downshift that would over-rev the engine (a money shift bends valves or blows it)
aids.revProtection.name: Rev protection
aids.steering.help: Keyboard and gamepad: full lock only turns as far as the tyres can use
aids.steering.name: Steering assist
aids.tc.help: Eases the throttle when the driven wheels spin
aids.tc.name: Traction control
consent.never: Never your name, email, IP address or location, never sold or shared. Change your mind in Settings → Privacy.
consent.text: With your OK, the game sends anonymous statistics to our own server: which tutorials and quests are finished, where new players stop, and how fast it runs on your kind of device.
consent.title: Help us make the game better?
controls.bindingsHelp: Choose a control, then press the key or button or move the axis (Esc cancels).
controls.holdToggleHelp: Toggle: press once to turn on, again to turn off, instead of holding the key or button down.
controls.noPads: No gamepad or wheel seen yet — press a button on it.
controls.reset: Reset the controls to their defaults
damage.help: Full: dents, broken glass and lights, parts lose condition, and the mechanicals take damage (bent steering and suspension, punctures, a leaking radiator, a grinding gearbox; a huge hit can tear a wheel off). Visual only: the dents and breakages, none of the mechanical effects. Off: none (the crash sounds stay).
dock.schoolTip: Driving school: short lessons with medals
dock.towTip: Tow to the nearest garage (a small fee, click twice) — or drive into one: they're the blue drive-through buildings
first.label: First steps
first.npcRace.text: Some quests are races against rivals. Find one on the map — rivals drive the same physics you do.
first.npcRace.title: Race the locals
first.part.text: The shop in the garage has parts for your car. Buy one and fit it — then feel the difference on the road.
first.part.title: Your first upgrade
first.quest.text: Quests are races and challenges on real roads. Open the map (Tab) and pick one near you — the recommended ones suit your car.
first.quest.title: Your first quest
first.repair.text: Your car's taken some knocks. In the garage, the damage report shows what's hurt and what a repair costs.
first.repair.title: Fix the damage
garage.season.locked: {name} is from the {season} season shop ({item}, {price} Season Tokens). Earn tokens in the ROADBOOK and buy it there to use it.
garage.season.lockedUnknown: {name} is from a ROADBOOK season shop: buy it there to use it.
graphics.carDetailHelp: How far away cars are drawn whole (further: their body as one piece).
graphics.costKey: Shift+P shows what each frame costs
graphics.damageDetailHelp: How finely a crash dents the body.
graphics.detect: Test this computer and pick for me
graphics.deviceOnly: These stay on this device: another computer keeps its own.
graphics.dynamicResolutionHelp: Lowers the resolution by itself to keep the frame rate, never below the minimum.
graphics.effectsHelp: Particles, sparks and smoke: how many, how long they last, soft edges, little lights where sparks fly.
graphics.motionBlurHelp: The edges of the picture streak at speed (never with reduced motion).
graphics.none: The graphics settings are in the game.
graphics.now: now {scale}% resolution{limit, plural, =0 {} other {, at most # fps}}{saving, select, yes { (power saver)} other {}}
graphics.powerSaverHelp: At most 30 fps and a lower resolution — for laptops (on battery: where the browser can tell).
graphics.presetHelp: Low: older laptops and Chromebooks (30 fps). Medium: a typical laptop (60 fps). High: a gaming PC. Ultra: the most there is. Change anything below and it's Custom. None of it changes how the car drives.
language.help: The game is in English for now; more languages will come.
language.placeKinds.english: English names where there are some
language.placeNamesHelp: Suburb and city names come from OpenStreetMap: in the local language, or in English where mappers have added one. Changes when the map next loads.
language.unitsHelp: Only what you read changes: the cars drive the same.
map.routeInQuest: Finish the quest first: routes are for driving freely
music.build: Builds on the last lap and in a close race
music.buildHelp: The race music gets more intense on the final lap, or when a rival is right with you.
music.streamerSafeHelp: Only music cleared for streams and videos. All of the game's music is its own, so it's always safe; this stays on in case licensed music is ever added.

notify.newsHelp: The news panel lights up when there's something new.
notify.patchNotesHelp: A short list of changes the first time you play after an update.
onboard.starter.about.hana_roadster: A light two-seat roadster: nimble and playful, it rewards smooth hands.
onboard.starter.about.starter_car: A front-engined coupé: steady, easy to read, a good all-rounder.
onboard.starter.later: You can only pick once, at the start. Other cars are in the shop.
onboard.starter.text: Both are cheap to run and forgiving to learn on. You can buy others later.
onboard.starter.title: Pick your first car
onboard.tutorial.finished: Tutorial done — the map (Tab) shows quests near you.
onboard.tutorial.text: Five minutes on a real road: throttle and braking, cornering, the racing line, and what the tyres and sounds tell you. Then we'll suggest the driving aids that suit you.
onboard.tutorial.title: A short guided drive
onboard.welcome.guestNote: As a guest your progress is kept on this device; make an account any time and it comes with you.
onboard.welcome.signIn: Sign in or make an account
onboard.welcome.text: Drive real roads in real cities, race rivals, and build your car up from the garage.
onboard.welcome.title: Welcome to Ogni Strada
photo.help: WASD or the left stick to move, drag or the right stick to look, Q and E down and up, the wheel to zoom. H hides the HUD.
photo.opened: Photo mode on. Esc leaves it.
photo.savedNoShare: Sharing isn't available here, so it's been saved instead.
photo.title: Photo mode
privacy.analyticsHelp: Which tutorials and quests are finished, where new players stop, and how fast the game runs on your kind of device, so we can fix what's hard. Kept on our own server, never sold or shared, never with your name, email or exact location. You can change your mind here at any time.
privacy.yourData: A copy of your data, or delete your account
profile.crewNeedsAccount: Crews need a full account (a guest can make one any time).
profile.noCrew: Not in a crew. Make one, or join with an invite code.
profile.noPhotos: No photos yet: take some in photo mode.
profile.public: Other players can see my profile
profile.title: Profile
school.fail.overshot: You went past the line — brake earlier.
school.fail.tooSlow: Too slow — go faster this time.
school.goals: Bronze {bronze} · Silver {silver} · Gold {gold} ({better, select, lower {lower is better} other {higher is better}})
school.intro: Short lessons that teach how the cars really behave. Each medal earns a small reward the first time.
school.lesson.braking-zone.lesson: Braking points: brake earlier than feels natural, then ease off the pedal as you slow.
school.lesson.braking-zone.text: Reach 100 km/h, then stop with your front wheels on the white line.
school.lesson.braking-zone.title: Braking zones
school.lesson.car-control.lesson: Look ahead to the next cone, not the one beside you: your hands follow your eyes.
school.lesson.car-control.text: Weave through the slalom without touching a cone, as quickly as you can.
school.lesson.car-control.title: Car control
school.lesson.cornering-line.lesson: A straighter line through a bend lets you carry more speed with the same grip.
school.lesson.cornering-line.text: Drive through every gate as fast as you can. Wide in, clip the apex, wide out.
school.lesson.cornering-line.title: The racing line
school.lesson.drift-intro.lesson: Steer into the slide and balance it with the throttle: more throttle, more angle.
school.lesson.drift-intro.text: Stability and traction control are off. On the circle, kick the rear out and hold the slide for as long as you can in 30 seconds.
school.lesson.drift-intro.title: Your first drift
school.lesson.threshold-braking.lesson: A locked tyre slides and can't steer: the shortest stop is just short of locking — listen for the squeal and hold it there.
school.lesson.threshold-braking.text: ABS is off. From 100 km/h, stop in the shortest distance without locking the wheels.
school.lesson.threshold-braking.title: Threshold braking
school.lesson.trail-braking.lesson: Easing off the brake while turning keeps weight on the front tyres, so the car turns in sharply.
school.lesson.trail-braking.text: Enter at 110 km/h and keep braking lightly as you turn in, then carry as much speed out of the corner as you can.
school.lesson.trail-braking.title: Trail braking
school.lesson.wet-control.lesson: In the wet the tyres have far less grip: every input has to be smoother.
school.lesson.wet-control.text: The same course, soaked. Brake earlier, turn more gently and be patient with the throttle.
school.lesson.wet-control.title: Wet driving
school.tip.brakeHard: Brake as hard as you can without locking!
school.tip.entrySpeed: Reach 110 km/h before the first gate
school.tip.trail: Trail the brake into the corner
school.title: Driving school
settings.aidsAdvice: Which aids suit my driving? (a short drive)
settings.crashReplayHelp: A short slow-motion replay after a big crash (any key skips it). Never in a race.
settings.handbrakeClutchHelp: Keeps the engine revving through handbrake turns
settings.hints: First-time hints and guided first steps
settings.hintsHelp: A short tip the first time you meet something new, and the guided first steps (your first quest, repair, part and race). Each can be skipped.
settings.questNoticesHelp: While free roaming, a small notice now and then when you pass a quest you haven't played.
settings.rehint: Show the hints and first steps again
settings.rubberBandHelp: Rivals ease off a little when well ahead of you, and push a little when behind (their driving only, never their car). Never in pink slips.
settings.sessionHelp: A test drive: cars hit with full damage, R puts loose parts back on. A race: reduced damage from other cars, R keeps all the damage, no free repairs — Backspace twice tows the car to the garage, ending the race.
settings.sync.offline: Offline: saved on this device, sent when you're back
settings.title: Settings
share.beat: {by} challenges you: beat {time}{cls, select, other { in class {cls}} none {}}
sound.lowHelp: Low: fewer other cars heard in full, the engines' simpler sound, no echoes, and no muffling behind buildings.
touch.label: On-screen driving controls
tutorial.advice.clean: You drove cleanly — try {aid} off for a more direct feel.
tutorial.advice.lockup: Turn {aid} on: the wheels locked under braking.
tutorial.advice.none: Your aids suit how you drive. Leave them as they are.
tutorial.advice.slides: Turn {aid} on: it helps catch the car when it slides.
tutorial.advice.spins: Turn {aid} on: the car spun round a couple of times.
tutorial.advice.wheelspin: Turn {aid} on: the wheels spun often when you accelerated.
tutorial.assists.title: Your driving aids
tutorial.assists.where: You can change any of these later in Settings (O) → Gameplay → Driver aids.
tutorial.braking.text: From speed, brake firmly (S, ↓, or the left trigger) to a stop. ABS stops the wheels locking, so you can still steer while braking hard.
tutorial.braking.title: Brake to a stop
tutorial.cornering.text: Take two turns cleanly: brake while you're straight, turn in once you've slowed, and only add throttle as you unwind the steering.
tutorial.cornering.title: Slow in, then turn
tutorial.line.text: Go wide before a corner, clip the inside at its middle (the apex), and let the car run wide on the way out. The straighter your path, the faster you can go — take a turn at speed this way.
tutorial.line.title: The racing line
tutorial.throttle.text: Press the throttle (W, ↑, or the right trigger) and build up to 40 km/h. Squeeze it on gently — stamping on it just spins the wheels.
tutorial.throttle.title: Get going
tutorial.tyres.text: Push a little harder in a bend until the tyres start to squeal: that's the edge of their grip. Ease off as it gets louder. (With "Show important sounds" on, the tyre outline fills up the same way.)
tutorial.tyres.title: Listen to the tyres
